candidates.sentence: Murphy will continue to fight for the Second Amendment rights for North Carolina’s Third District.
Yet thanks to out of control government spending, the fight for lower taxes for the American people must continue.
Murphy has cosponsored numerous other bills to protect the lives of the unborn.
He fundamentally believes in the constitutional right to bear arms for law-abiding citizens so they may protect themselves and their families.
Murphy has spent his time in Congress fighting to simplify the tax code for working families and to lower the rates they have to pay, regardless of income.
As our debt continues to rise irresponsibly under democratic rule, he has pledged to cut the amount of money the government spends annually.
